theorems.name: Submission.chart_coarea_jacobian_identification
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N m : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (θ : Rn N → ℝ) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (Γ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m), θ x ≠ 0 → Function.Injective A → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap) → (∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (Γ w) x (A w)) → approxTangentPlane n M θ x = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap ∧ (∃ L : ↥(LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap) →L[ℝ] Rn m, HasTangentialDifferentialAt (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap) f x L) ∧ coareaJacobian (approxTangentPlane n M θ x) f x * A.toLinearMap.normDet = (A.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ.toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint Γ.toLinearMap).normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
